title: Harvey Absorbs Aida Search Team to Build Private Data Infrastructure for Law Firms
summary:
Piyush Prahladka, a co-founder of the enterprise search company Glean, has joined the legal AI platform Harvey as part of a move to absorb the engineering and research staff from the Aida startup. Prahladka and teammate Atish Das Sarma will lead the implementation of new search and machine learning tools designed to help Harvey's AI agents better organize the internal information used in legal work.

The integration focuses on the creation of private ontologies for legal clients, which are context layers that connect a firm's internal data and convert it into owned intellectual property. These systems will be accessible through APIs and can be hosted on-premises for law firms requiring full control over their data and privacy.

selectedTweets.text:
Excited to welcome @piyprah @atishdassarma and the rest of the @get_aida team to Harvey.

Piyush co-founded Glean and we met a couple years ago when he was starting Aida.

At Aida, they were building Harvey for sales and a lot of the product and infrastructure they were building was things we had been planning.

He became someone I regularly turned to for advice when I was thinking through enterprise search and related technical strategies.

A couple months ago when we decided to focus more on these efforts they were the first team we turned to to help lead these.

Together we're going to build each firm its own ontology: a private context layer that connects all of its data and turns it into IP the firm owns.

That context makes every agent and model and product the firm uses better and stays private and portable through our APIs and will be able to run on-prem for firms that want full control.

A firm's context is its edge and the firms that own theirs will be the ones that stand apart.
